text: The clinic is clean, the service is good, the doctor is kind and very gentle. The assistants are also very lovely. The price is affordable and it's close to home. 🥰 …

This is the first time my 5-year-old hasn't been afraid of going to the dentist. The dentist was very kind, held my child's hand, introduced herself, took her into the treatment room, let my child see and touch the dental equipment, and explained every step of the process. She promised to stop after counting to five, and she really kept her promise. My child trusted her. This clinic takes care of not only the teeth but also the child's emotional well-being.
Thank you!
I highly recommend this clinic for children.
